_comment: Hand-verified venue-name → place-id map. Automatic matching in build.py is deliberately strict (exact name, or a full distinctive-token subset) because a wrong venue on a page is worse than no venue: loose 'contains' matching produced Araksa Tea Garden → 'Garden Restaurant' and Bua Bhat Factory → 'Fact Café'. This file is where a human pins the ones strict matching cannot reach. Field truth, per data/curated/ convention — importers must never overwrite it.
_precision: Use `approx: true` where the pinned record is the containing institution rather than the exact room or building, so the page can say so instead of implying a precise fix.

cmu.why: Meetup venue string 'CMU' = Chiang Mai University campus (มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่). Sunset walks meet at the campus entrance.

lifelong learning payap center.why: Payap University (มหาวิทยาลัยพายัพ). The Lifelong Learning centre sits on the Kaew Nawarat campus; the catalogue record is the university itself.

wat tung yu.why: วัดทุงยู — hosts the Friday games night and meditation retreats via Buddha Daily Wisdom.

_missing_from_catalogue._comment: Event venues confirmed NOT present in the 10,281-record catalogue as of 2026-07-29. These are real coverage gaps and good candidates for a targeted crawl or a 'send the ants' request — an events feed naming a venue we do not have is itself a discovery signal.
